Title: Holy Rosary
Subtitle: The Complete Rosary
IntroText: The Holy Rosary is a beloved Marian devotion meditating on the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus through 20 mysteries. Each decade consists of one Our Father, ten Hail Marys, and a Glory Be.

Blocks.Text: The Holy Rosary
How to Pray the Rosary
Make the Sign of the Cross
Pray the Apostles' Creed
Pray the Our Father
Pray 3 Hail Marys for an increase of Faith, Hope and Charity
Pray the Glory Be
Announce the First Mystery and pray the Our Father
Pray 10 Hail Marys while meditating on the Mystery
Pray the Glory Be and the Fatima Prayer
Repeat steps 6–8 for each Mystery
After all 5 decades, pray the Hail Holy Queen
The Joyful Mysteries
Prayed on Mondays and Saturdays
The Annunciation — The angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will bear the Son of God.
The Visitation — Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth, who is also with child.
The Nativity — Jesus is born in a manger in Bethlehem.
The Presentation — Jesus is presented at the Temple and consecrated to God.
The Finding of Jesus in the Temple — Jesus, lost for three days, is found in the Temple.
The Sorrowful Mysteries
Prayed on Tuesdays and Fridays
The Agony in the Garden — Jesus prays in Gethsemane, sweating blood in His anguish.
The Scourging at the Pillar — Jesus is bound and scourged by Roman soldiers.
The Crowning with Thorns — A crown of thorns is placed upon Jesus' head.
The Carrying of the Cross — Jesus carries His cross to Calvary.
The Crucifixion — Jesus is nailed to the cross and dies for our sins.
The Glorious Mysteries
Prayed on Wednesdays and Sundays
The Resurrection — Jesus rises gloriously from the dead on Easter Sunday.
The Ascension — Jesus ascends to heaven forty days after His resurrection.
The Descent of the Holy Spirit — The Holy Spirit descends on the apostles at Pentecost.
The Assumption of Mary — Mary is taken body and soul into heaven.
The Coronation of Mary — Mary is crowned as Queen of Heaven and Earth.
The Luminous Mysteries
Prayed on Thursdays
The Baptism of Jesus — Jesus is baptised in the Jordan; the Father declares Him His beloved Son.
The Wedding at Cana — At Mary's intercession, Jesus changes water into wine.
The Proclamation of the Kingdom — Jesus calls all to conversion and announces the Kingdom.
The Transfiguration — Jesus is transfigured on Mount Tabor.
The Institution of the Eucharist — Jesus gives us His Body and Blood at the Last Supper.
Fatima Prayer (after each decade)
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell,
lead all souls to heaven,
especially those who are in most need of Your mercy.
Closing: Hail Holy Queen
Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope...
Amen.
